mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 110, it signals manufacturing sector weakness that typically precedes reduced corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during economic slowdowns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO < 110, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment growth signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific thresholds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS growth is positive for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1900 thousand units, it signals strong consumer confidence and increased construction activity, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST > 1900, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in the federal funds rate and rising consumer price inflation above 2.5% indicate a central bank's attempt to stimulate the economy amid inflation, historically leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in retail sales indicates sustained consumer spending strength that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without requiring specific thresholds.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS shows a 3-month rising trend, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
